cases.note: §36.4: the bus says sag and the gauge says full. The gauge is not consulted, because a gauge that disagrees with the bus is a gauge that is wrong.
A degraded RHAL with a code this vendor did not call a brownout. The OS matches a declared list; §24 forbids it interpreting a vendor code, so a code that is not on the list is not a sag.

The gap §36.4 has until a vendor fills it in: the RHAL is degraded and nothing on this body can tell a voltage sag from a dead encoder. Reported, and the robot keeps working — a hole in a declaration is not a reason to stop a machine.
